profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Howdy! I'm a senior software engineer who enjoys collaborating with fellow developers, testers, product managers, and stakeholders, each of us honing our various crafts, growing individually in order to grow collectively, as a team and as a business. 

I enjoy writing well-tested, modular code which expresses the business domain with such clarity that developers can learn about and understand the domain just by reading the code.

I value both autonomy and individual initiative, as well as robust communication and collaboration with various stakeholders, shifting the balance of the two to best match the moment at hand.

When I'm not coding at work, I can be found coding for fun, or else fixing up fresh recipes in the kitchen, tending to the garden in my backyard, or cycling about the city or else to greener spaces.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Redesigned calculating & handling of double-entry accounting, significantly decreasing manual labor and increasing overall confidence in our books
• Began rewrite of core logic for handling customer billing and refunds, (again) significantly decreasing manual labor
• Wrote other features for helping to automate various accountant workflows in possible, either in whole or in part
• Owned engineering efforts to handle fallout of Hurricane Ian and stay compliant with various emergency orders
• Worked on prod support rotation, locating the root of bugs and leveraging advanced SQL queries to locate & rectify issues en masse
• Independently took courses in home insurance & accounting to improve communication with stakeholders and increase expressivity of code
positions.insights: Ruby, Ruby on Rails and +14 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintained our client portal (Ruby/Rails) and its integrations with our Java monolith, a number of microservices, and third party vendors as well
• Wrote a greenfield microservice using Clojure, RabbitMQ and Datomic, increasing the speed of long-running processes by over 30%
• Used Datomic as a graph database to manage complex webs of permissions and access to legal documents
• Coordinated with other teams and departments for major releases, database upgrades, and disaster plans drills
positions.insights: Ruby, Ruby on Rails and +12 skills

positions.title: Junior Developer
positions.description: • 19-week intensive/immersive coding tradeschool program, where I learned Ruby/Rails, as well as HTML, CSS, JavaScript (jQuery and ajax), Bootstrap, MySQL, dabbled in MongoDB, etc.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Double Major in History, Political Science
